taker.description: Taker address to filter trades by; returns all trades executed by this address

pagination.description: Standard pagination parameters; results ordered by trade ID ascending

key.description: key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key should be set.

offset.description: offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable. It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should be set.

limit.description: limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page. If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description: count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs. count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key is set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title: Page Request
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.description: PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient pagination. Ex:  message SomeRequest {          Foo some_parameter = 1;          PageRequest pagination = 2;  }

trades.description: List of trades executed by the specified taker

pagination.description: Pagination metadata for result set navigation

next_key.description: next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if there are no more results.

total.description: total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.title: Page Response
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.description: PageResponse is to be embedded in gRPC response messages where the corresponding request message has used PageRequest.  message SomeResponse {          repeated Bar results = 1;          PageResponse page = 2;  }

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.title: Coin
cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description: Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount. NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method signatures required by gogoproto.

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.AuctionRedeem.title: Auction Redeem
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.AuctionRedeem.description: AuctionRedeem operation for recording auction redemption in Trade history

swap_in.description: Exactly one of swap_in (exact-in) or swap_out (exact-out) must be set (XOR). Use message-level max_input and min_output for global constraints across legs.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer to take from; offer must exist and be in open status.

take_units.description: Units to take (sdk.Int string). If empty, take full remaining. Must be positive and ≤ remaining.

trader.description: ═════ NEW FIELDS (fields 20+) ═════ Trader address (was taker in old schema, field 3)

height.description: Block height when trade was executed (was field 4 in old schema)

timestamp.description: Timestamp when trade was executed (was field 5 in old schema)

operations.description: Operations executed in this trade (from tx.proto TradeOperation). Each operation records what was sent/received for that specific step. Replaces offer_id/pool_id/auction_id fields (2, 8, 9) from old schema.

total_sent.description: Aggregated totals across all operations (was single sent field 6)

total_received.description: Aggregated totals across all operations (was single received field 7)

note.description: Optional note (was field 10 in old schema)

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.Trade.title: Trade
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.Trade.description: Trade captures a batch of operations executed atomically in a single message. Operations are stored in execution order, preserving the exact sequence from the original message (MsgMakeTrade, MsgPoolSwap, MsgTakeOffer, MsgRedeemAuction).

fees_paid.description: Fees paid for swap operations in the INPUT denom (populated for swaps, zero for takes/auctions).

dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.TradeOperatio.title: Trade Operation
dysonprotocol.whaleswap.v1.TradeOperatio.description: TradeOperation allows mixing pool swap legs, orderbook takes, and auction redemptions. When stored in Trade.operations, sent/received fields are populated with execution results. When used in MsgMakeTrade.operations, sent/received are empty (populated during execution).
